description: Expose the DMS-1320 CDC provider setup contract to production consumers without adding a user-facing CDC setup CLI. The public surface should let 19-04/bootstrap code obtain emitted CDC inventory, construct a setup request, invoke provider setup, and consume the typed result, while provider step composition remains internal implementation detail.
acceptance-criteria: Production assemblies outside EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl can compile against the CDC setup request/result DTOs, setup mode/outcome enums, provider/artifact/diagnostic enums, safe-name and fingerprint types, source inventory DTOs, artifact-name factory methods, nullable probe factory interface, database executor abstraction, and DbConnection-backed executor adapter needed to call setup.

Production assemblies can obtain the ordinary DDL-emitted CDC source inventory and DMS-managed table inventory for dms.Document, dms.DocumentCache, and dms.CdcHeartbeat without using InternalsVisibleTo.
A public DI extension registers the built-in PostgreSQL and SQL Server setup providers for production callers.
ICdcProviderSetupProvider, CdcProviderSetupStep, CdcProviderSetupStepContext, CdcProviderSetupStepResult, and provider-specific step internals remain internal.
The change does not add a supported user-facing CDC setup command and does not hide CDC setup inside ordinary ddl emit/provision.
The EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl project no longer relies on test-only InternalsVisibleTo as the only path for SchemaTools/bootstrap-style production consumers to call CDC setup.
steps-to-verify: Add a production-assembly compile-time test that builds DDL emission metadata, constructs CdcProviderSetupRequest, and invokes the setup service through the public surface.
Run the relevant SchemaTools tests that exercise CDC provider setup from outside the DDL assembly.

description: Restore compile-time coupling between emitted DDL and runtime inventory validation for the DocumentProjectionWork primary key and DocumentCache ComputedAt default constraint.
acceptance-criteria: CoreDdlEmitter uses DocumentCacheInventoryDefinition.DocumentProjectionWorkConstraints.PrimaryKey instead of the literal PK_DocumentProjectionWork.
DmsCoreTableDefinitions uses DocumentCacheInventoryDefinition.DocumentCacheConstraints.ComputedAtDefault instead of the literal DF_DocumentCache_ComputedAt.
No unrelated pre-existing literals such as PK_Document, PK_CdcHeartbeat, and DF_Document_* are changed as part of this task.
Existing golden/snapshot expectations still pass without updates.

description: Remove dead DMS-managed-table kind plumbing from the PostgreSQL and SQL Server CDC connector-principal access SQL. The access queries only need schema/table identity for DMS-managed table grant checks.
acceptance-criteria: The dms_managed_table_inventory CTEs in PostgreSQL and SQL Server connector-principal access SQL declare only schema and table/object name columns.
PostgresqlDmsManagedTableInventoryValues and SqlServerDmsManagedTableInventoryValues emit only schema and table/object name values.
Both private DmsManagedTableKindToken helpers are removed so Sonar S1144 cannot flag unused private members.
The unreachable empty-inventory SQL branches are removed because CdcDmsManagedTableInventoryContract.Normalize rejects an empty inventory before providers run.
The SQL Server capture-instance query keeps its separate expected_capture_instances table_kind logic because it represents CDC source table kind, not DMS-managed table inventory kind.
steps-to-verify: Run the PostgreSQL and SQL Server CDC provider access tests affected by connector-principal grant validation.

description: Make SQL Server gating-role grant detection use an explicit ordinal string comparison for the role. diagnostic prefix check.
acceptance-criteria: CdcProviderSetupService uses StartsWith("role.", StringComparison.Ordinal) for SQL Server gating-role grant detection.
No other string comparison semantics are changed.
The change preserves existing CDC_BINDING_SQLSERVER_GATING_ROLE_NAME_MISMATCH behavior.

description: Simplify CdcProviderArtifactOutputRequest.ShouldCreateManifestPayload while keeping the property as the call-site intent expression used by CdcProviderSetupService.
acceptance-criteria: ShouldCreateManifestPayload returns IncludeManifestPayload only.
The constructor continues to set IncludeManifestPayload to true when ManifestOutputDirectoryPath is supplied.
CdcProviderSetupService continues to call ShouldCreateManifestPayload rather than duplicating manifest-output logic inline.
Manifest payload and file-output behavior remains unchanged for IncludeManifestPayload=true, ManifestOutputDirectoryPath supplied, and neither option supplied.

description: Verify that SQL Server projection prerequisite warnings stay separate from provider-history continuity diagnostics. This guards the already-correct behavior where RCSI and nested-trigger warnings are reported as validation/prerequisite observations rather than source-history unknown.
acceptance-criteria: CDC_SQLSERVER_READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT_OFF is emitted with category ValidationMismatch, severity Warning, and classification None.
CDC_SQLSERVER_NESTED_TRIGGERS_NOT_ENABLED is emitted with category ValidationMismatch, severity Warning, and classification None.
CDC_SQLSERVER_CDC_JOB_DISABLED, CDC_SQLSERVER_CAPTURE_JOB_NOT_RUNNING, and true provider-history read failures continue to use provider-history categories/classifications as appropriate.
The provider manifest's validation_diagnostics section reflects the corrected category and classification values for RCSI and nested-trigger warnings.
steps-to-verify: Inspect CdcSqlServerHeartbeatDatabaseProvider diagnostics helper usage to confirm RCSI and nested-trigger checks call the projection-prerequisite warning path, not ProviderHistoryWarning.

description: Harden SqlServerCaptureInstanceInspection by carrying typed has_drop_pending and heartbeat_capture_visible values instead of re-reading display strings from SafeObservedValues for control flow.
acceptance-criteria: SqlServerCaptureInstanceInspection contains typed values for HasDropPending and HeartbeatCaptureVisible.
IsDropPending and HeartbeatCaptureVisibilityIsUnavailable use the typed fields rather than dictionary lookups of "True"/"False" strings.
SafeObservedValues remains available for manifest and diagnostic output and keeps the existing stable keys.
CaptureInstanceHistoryClassification continues reading SafeObservedValues for mixed CdcProviderArtifactObservation inputs.
Existing tests for CDC_SQLSERVER_CAPTURE_INSTANCE_DROP_PENDING and CDC_SQLSERVER_HEARTBEAT_CAPTURE_NOT_VISIBLE still assert the specific diagnostics.

description: Preserve the provider-local implementation boundary for DMS-1320 review follow-up. Do not change cross-provider helper utilities as part of this focused cleanup.
acceptance-criteria: No new shared abstraction is introduced for provider-specific setup steps, SQL builders, diagnostics, and provider bodies as part of the focused review cleanup.
No cross-provider helper utility changes are made as part of this focused review cleanup.
Provider-specific helpers such as BuildHeartbeatActionQuery, CreateHeartbeatTableSql, InsertHeartbeatSingletonSql, SetupPrincipalFailure, and ReadRequired remain provider-local.
Current PostgreSQL and SQL Server manifest output and diagnostics ordering remain unchanged by this scope-control task.
steps-to-verify: Review the diff and confirm no broad shared provider utility layer was introduced.
Run the focused CDC provider unit tests for both PostgreSQL and SQL Server after the review cleanup.

description: Preserve the current failed-setup expected_message_key_columns manifest behavior and record 19-02 as the owner of any future connector-template requirement change.
acceptance-criteria: DMS-1320 does not change provider setup ordering solely to force expected_message_key_columns into failed PostgreSQL manifests.
PostgreSQL continues emitting expected message-key metadata only after publication/replica-identity validation reaches the existing step that produces it.
SQL Server continues emitting expected message-key metadata from source-inventory setup where it is currently available.
Any new requirement for expected message keys on failed provider setup is added to the owning 19-02 design/story before implementation.
steps-to-verify: Run existing CdcProviderManifest and provider setup tests to confirm no unintended manifest shape change occurred.
Record any new 19-02 requirement in the design before implementing it.

description: Verify that CDC_BINDING_CONNECTOR_PRINCIPAL_MISMATCH remains produced and tested, because the review note identifying it as dead code is stale for the current checkout.
acceptance-criteria: CdcProviderSetupService still emits CDC_BINDING_CONNECTOR_PRINCIPAL_MISMATCH when connector-principal grant observations use a different safe principal than the request connector principal.
Unit tests assert CDC_BINDING_CONNECTOR_PRINCIPAL_MISMATCH alongside work-table grant violation coverage.
No new production behavior is added for this stale review note.
steps-to-verify: Confirm the producer and test remain present.
